document_metadata.title: 162、INT. INTERROGATION ROOM - BUFFALO - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Eddie Vibes is interrogated by a detective who demands to know his accomplices; despite being beaten, Eddie refuses to betray anyone, asserting he's not a rat.

entities.name: Detective interrogates Eddie Vibes about his accomplices
entities.description: An unseen detective questions Eddie Vibes, demanding to know who helped him in his criminal activity, showing increasing frustration and aggression.

entities.name: Detective slaps Eddie Vibes and knocks him to the ground
entities.description: After receiving an unsatisfactory answer, the detective violently slaps Eddie, causing him to fall under the table and land on the floor.

entities.name: Detective presses boot into Eddie Vibes' face
entities.description: The detective intensifies the physical intimidation by placing his boot on Eddie's face and pressing down, further humiliating and injuring him.

entities.name: Eddie Vibes declares he is not a rat despite being called a liar and a loser
entities.description: While being physically oppressed, Eddie asserts his loyalty and personal code by refusing to name accomplices, stating that while he may be many bad things, he is not an informant.

entities.name: Eddie Vibes smiles under physical duress
entities.description: Despite having his face crushed by the detective's boot, Eddie manages a distorted, defiant smile, signaling resilience or psychological resistance.
